other_conditions: Must be a merit student selected through an exam conducted by the Directorate of School Education
Not applicable to students studying in private schools
Not applicable to students receiving financial assistance from other government education schemes
Not applicable to students who have repeated classes or are over‑age for their class
Not applicable to students with poor academic performance
Not applicable to students who are absent from school for a significant period of time
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance covering tuition fees, textbooks, uniforms and other education expenses to eligible children.
